senses.gloss: f.(b. h. רְפָתִים pl.; cmp. רָפַף a. cattle-shed, stall.
units: <cite ref="Pesachim 8a:6">Pes. 8ᵃ</cite> <he>ר׳ בקר</he> ox-stall. Y. ib. IV, 31ᵇ <he>שבר׳ וכ׳</he> (<cite ref="G00044"><he>זבל</he></cite>) the dung of a stall whether large or small.
<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Batra 6:4">Ib. VI, 4</cite> <he>ר׳ בקר הוא זה</he> this (four cubits by six) is a stall (but not a dwelling); a. fr.
